verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams supports a published app ecosystem (bots, tabs, message extensions, connectors) that admins can add to channels, e.g. Incoming/Outgoing Webhooks and Connectors for subscribing to third-party services, and a 'Publish your agents or apps in Teams' flow implying a store/directory. However, none of the evidence explicitly describes the admin-facing app directory/marketplace install experience (Teams Admin Center app management, org-wide app policies) — missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Teams app store/marketplace browsing and install-for-org flow, admin app policy management, and independent confirmation of ease of use for admins.
